brief:
Israeli forces raided the village of Lubban al-Sharqiya in the central West Bank, leaving multiple residents with asphyxiation injuries, Shehab Wire reported. The military operation saw troops enter the village and deploy what appeared to be tear gas or similar chemical agents against residents present during the incursion.

Lubban al-Sharqiya has endured repeated Israeli military operations over years of occupation. Residents suffered breathing difficulties and related respiratory distress as a result of exposure to the gas deployed during the raid. The specific objective of the operation and its full duration remained unclear from available reports at the time of filing.
